expert.title: Expert mode
expert.modeInfo: Unlocks an Expert page where you can override the power (wattage) values used for the energy estimate.
expert.powerInfo: Wattage used to estimate energy use. Defaults match your spa model; adjust to your actual hardware.
expert.heatLossInfo: Heat loss (W per Kelvin) is one factor in the "time to target temperature" estimate. You can enter it manually here or calibrate it automatically.
expert.calInfo: The calibration measures how fast your spa cools down. This tells WifiWhirl how much heat is lost, so it can predict more accurately when the target temperature will be reached.
expert.calConfirm: This switches off the heater, AirJet and HydroJet, switches on the filter pump and, if needed, sets the display to °C for the duration. Then the cool-down time between two sensor steps is measured. This can take several hours. Start the calibration?
expert.calTips:
For the best result:
The water must be at least {min} °C warmer than outside. The warmer it is, the faster it goes.
Ideally start it in the evening or at night so the sun doesn't disturb the measurement.
Keep the cover closed and don't use the spa in the meantime.
The measurement usually takes a few hours, 36 hours at most.
In the meantime the heater and jets are off and the filter pump runs. At the end, WifiWhirl sets everything back the way it was.
expert.calPreparing: Preparing: pump on, heater/jets off - letting the water circulate…
expert.calAbort.tempdiff: The scheduled calibration did not start: the water was only {d} °C warmer than the surroundings, at least {min} °C are needed.
expert.calWaitTick: Status: waiting until the reading steps down once to the start value.
expert.calRestoring: The spa changed its pump/heater state - restoring the measuring state…
expert.calDiscarded: {n} measuring interval(s) discarded and restarted (e.g. mixing or sloshing) - this is normal, the measurement keeps running.
expert.calErr.tempdiff: For an accurate measurement the water must be at least {min} °C warmer than the surroundings.
expert.calAbort.prep: Calibration stopped because the spa did not reach the required pump/heater state.
expert.calAbort.interrupted: Calibration stopped because the pump/heater state changed and could not be restored within 5 minutes.
expert.calAbort.timeout: Calibration stopped because the water did not cool enough within 36 hours.
expert.calAbort.unstable: Calibration stopped because the measured temperature drop was not plausible.
expert.calPlanHint: The calibration starts once at the chosen time, ideally in the evening or at night without sun. If the water isn't warm enough compared to the surroundings at that point, it won't start and you'll see the reason here.

backup.confirm: The settings from the file replace the current ones. WifiWhirl restarts afterwards. Continue?

backup.invalid: The file is not a valid WifiWhirl backup.

device.title: Device settings
ss.targetReachedStatus: Target temperature reached - the heater is holding the temperature.
ss.repeatHint: After the target time, the schedule is automatically set again for the next occurrence.
ss.intro: Set when the spa should reach the target temperature. WifiWhirl computes the heating start automatically.
ss.helpIntro: WifiWhirl calculates the heating start from the current water temperature, target temperature, ambient temperature and spa volume.
ss.helpMeasure: Before scheduling, the pump is briefly activated to measure an accurate water temperature.
ss.helpAdaptive: Adaptive checks update the estimate as the target time approaches.
ss.helpTarget: At the target time, the spa should be at the selected temperature. Afterwards either everything switches off, only the filter pump keeps running until you switch it off, or the heater holds the set temperature.
ss.errTempRange: Target temperature must be between 20°C and 40°C.
ss.errFuture: Target time must be in the future.
ss.tooLate: The time until the target time is probably not enough to reach the target temperature. Heating starts immediately.
ss.confirmCancel: Do you really want to cancel the schedule?
auto.emptyHint: Choose a command, set the time, and add it to the queue.
auto.saveEmpty: Saving an empty queue is not useful.
auto.repeatOnceHint: Runs once at the selected time.
auto.repeatHint: The command repeats from the selected start time.
auto.dailyPumpRunHint: Create a daily filter pump window with automatic start and stop commands.
auto.dailyPumpRunPreview: Overnight windows are supported; the stop command will run the next day.
auto.invalidTimeWindow: Start and end time must be different.
auto.plannerHint: Create one-time or repeating commands for your spa.
auto.confirmClear: Do you really want to clear the queue? All scheduled commands will be deleted.
auto.queueChanged: The queue changed in the meantime (e.g. a command ran). Please check the list and try again.
dev.authInfo: Optional password protection for the whole web interface. Device name, fallback Wi-Fi password and OTA/update password can only be changed once login is enabled.
dev.authResetInfo: Enabling or changing the password restarts the module. The button sequence POWER - LOCK - TIMER - POWER on the device resets the module and removes the login.
dev.webhookInfo: Webhooks let external systems call /hook/ to trigger WifiWhirl commands. Use them for automation platforms, smart-home scenes, HTTP buttons, scripts, or services such as Home Assistant and Node-RED.
dev.webhookAuthInfo: Optional HTTP Basic Auth protects webhook calls with a separate username and password, and the same credentials also guard the Prometheus /metrics endpoint. Leave it disabled only for trusted local networks or existing integrations that cannot send credentials.
dev.identityLocked: These settings can only be changed once global login is enabled.
dev.otaConfirmInfo: Enter the current OTA/update password to enable login.
dev.errHostname: Device name must be 1 to 32 letters, digits, or hyphens and cannot start or end with a hyphen.
dev.errApPwd: The fallback Wi-Fi password must be 8 to 63 characters long (or empty for an open fallback Wi-Fi).
dev.errOtaPwd: The OTA password must be at least 8 characters long.
cfg.readyHint: The key settings for a correct heat-up time calculation and Smart Schedule are fully set up.
cfg.attentionHint: Complete the highlighted setting before saving this profile.
cfg.essentialsHint: These values affect the heat-up time calculation, cost estimates and Smart Schedule.
cfg.nightTariffHint: Energy cost is accumulated with the tariff active at the time of use.
cfg.jetCountdown: Show remaining time on the control panel
cfg.jetCountdownHint: Briefly shows the remaining AirJet (“A12”) and HydroJet (“H12”) time every minute. In the last minute the seconds count down.
cfg.standbyOriginalHint: In standby the control panel shows the water temperature and °C/°F dimmed, like without WifiWhirl. When this is off, the control panel stays dark in standby.
cfg.buttonsInfo: Enable or disable individual buttons on the physical pump. Disabled buttons can only be controlled via WifiWhirl.
cfg.disableConfirm:
Warning!

Disabling the control buttons means the pump can only be controlled via the WifiWhirl module.

Are you sure?
cfg.hostModeInfo: For vacation rentals, Airbnb & hotels: guests operate the spa via the physical control panel only. Timer, power and the unit button (°C/°F) are locked; Airjet, Hydrojet, heater, pump, button lock and target temperature remain available.
cfg.hostHeaterTimeout: Heater off after reaching target temperature
cfg.hostHeaterTimeoutHint: 0 = disabled. When the time is up the heater turns off; pressing the heater button again starts a new cycle. The temperature limit is always in °C and only applies to the control panel - WebUI, MQTT and apps stay unrestricted.

info.webUpdateUpToDate: You are on the latest version.
info.webUpdateInstalling: Downloading and installing… do not disconnect power.
upd.wrongFile: This file is not intended for the software update!
upd.success: Upload successful! The WifiWhirl module is restarting. It may take up to 5 minutes to become reachable again.
upd.authFailed: Authentication failed - the update was not uploaded.
cfg.weatherFromCloud: The outdoor temperature comes from the cloud app, where the location is set.
cfg.weatherNeedsCloud: Weather data is only available with the cloud connection on. While it is off, you enter the outdoor temperature yourself on the overview. If you switch the cloud back on and a location is set there, weather data comes back on by itself.
dashboard.suggestWater: Recommendation: partial water change, drain about {l} liters and refill with fresh water
dashboard.suggestNote: Recommendations are guide values. Follow the instructions on the pack and measure again after about an hour of filtering.
cfg.dosingHint: WifiWhirl uses these to work out the water care recommendations. The defaults are the values for Bayrol SpaTime granules. If you use a different product, enter the values from your pack.
cfg.df.DFTAM: pH minus per 10 mg/l less TA
dashboard.suggestNoteTa: pH minus also lowers the pH. Measure it too and make sure it doesn't drop below 7.2.
